en.askTitle: Swap in your own course, apps and budget, and get a UK laptop comparison with dated prices and the buy-or-wait call
en.runTitle: One UK laptop for a part-time master's and a marketing job, up to about £1,000

fields.label: Job or course, exact apps and workload
fields.value: Part-time master's plus a marketing job: Microsoft 365, Canva, Zoom/Teams, lots of browser tabs, occasional light photo and video editing

fields.label: Currency and amount, laptop-only or all-in
Commute, screen and weight preferences
fields.value: Takes the train to work, so weight and battery matter; wants it to last 4+ years

en.template: Compare laptops in {place} by {date} for {use}, within {budget}, with {commute}. Check OS, exam, VPN, driver and local-app compatibility. Compare exact CPU, RAM, SSD, panel, keyboard, seller, condition, adapter, delivered price and dated stock. Separate public, verified student and unredeemed-code prices; include necessary charger/hub costs without assumed stacking. Use published tests and owner accounts, including criticism; distinguish exact versions from older tests, manufacturer maxima and lifespan hopes. Do not invent hands-on tests, ratings or four-year reliability. Recheck key primary pages and identify dated prices, later checks, failures and gaps. Explain returns and guarantees, recommend buy/wait thresholds and give payment checks. Do not buy, sign up, redeem codes, contact shops or publish.

phases.title: Check live UK shop prices, reviews and the buying terms that apply
phases.note: Apple, Currys, Argos, John Lewis and brand stores: exact models, prices with the date read, price-match and guarantee rules
phases.judgment: A cheap ASUS laptop was advertised with a 3K screen, but an owner of the exact same model reported Full HD. It recommended it only as a likely Full HD screen, not as a verified bargain.

phases.title: Build the linked comparison page and spreadsheet of specs and prices
phases.note: Every price carries its link and the date it was read

phases.title: Check the files against the evidence, then give the picks and the buy-or-wait call
phases.judgment: An independent audit re-checked the arithmetic and the configurations against the original pages and found nothing that had to be fixed. The final answer still says what could not be confirmed: Amazon UK prices and a purchasable John Lewis offer are left open rather than guessed.

workers: Checked Apple's UK prices, the education discount and eligibility, and the Surface option, with the original page text kept as evidence
Checked exact Windows thin-and-light models at UK retailers and what owners say, including the screen complaint on the ASUS
Read each shop's own price-match, student-offer, guarantee and returns terms, and noted what is excluded
Independent audit of the finished page and spreadsheet against the research: sums, specs, prices and offer conditions

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的课程、软件和预算，就能得到一份带日期价格、并告诉你现在买还是等的英国笔记本对比
zh.runTitle: 英国一台笔记本，兼顾在职硕士和市场营销工作，预算约 1000 英镑

fields.label: 工作、课程、具体软件和工作量
fields.value: 在职读硕士，同时做市场营销：Microsoft 365、Canva、Zoom/Teams、开很多浏览器标签，偶尔做简单的照片和视频剪辑

fields.label: 货币和金额，裸机或全套
通勤频率、屏幕和重量
fields.value: 坐火车上班，重量和续航重要；希望能用 4 年以上

zh.template: 请比较我在{place}、{date}前购买的笔记本：用于{use}，预算{budget}，偏好{commute}。先查操作系统、考试、VPN、驱动和本地软件是否适用。按具体 CPU、内存、SSD、面板、键盘、卖家、成色、适配器、送达价和库存日期比较。分清公开价、已核实学生价和未兑换优惠码价，算入必要充电器及扩展坞，不假设折扣叠加。看已发表评测和买家体验，也保留差评；分清具体版本、旧款测试、厂家最高值和寿命期待，不编造亲测、评分或四年可靠性。重查关键一手页面，标清价格日期、后续核查、失败和缺口。说明退货保障，给出买入或等待门槛及付款清单。不要购买、注册、兑换优惠码、联系商家或发布。

phases.title: 核对英国商店的现价、评测和适用的购买条款
phases.note: 苹果、Currys、Argos、John Lewis 等：具体型号、带读取日期的价格、比价和保修规则
phases.judgment: 一款便宜的华硕笔记本宣传 3K 屏，但同型号车主反馈实际是全高清。它只把这款作为「很可能是全高清屏」来推荐，没有当成已核实的超值款。

phases.title: 做出带链接的对比网页和规格价格表
phases.note: 每个价格都附链接和读取日期

phases.title: 对照证据检查文件，再给出推荐和买入或等待的建议
phases.judgment: 独立审核同事对照原始页面重新核对了算术和配置，没有发现必须修改的问题。最终答复仍写明没法确认的部分：亚马逊英国站的价格和 John Lewis 可购买的优惠留作未决，没有猜。

workers: 核对苹果英国站的价格、教育优惠和资格，以及 Surface 选项，并保留原始页面文字作为证据
核对英国商店里具体型号的轻薄 Windows 笔记本和车主评价，包括华硕那款屏幕的投诉
读各家商店自己的比价、学生优惠、保修和退货条款，记下哪些情况不适用
独立审核成稿网页和表格：对照调研核对合计、配置、价格和优惠条件
